clips.timing: Normalised compression grows as 1-exp(-holdMilliseconds/180); inferred from duration, never pressure hardware.

clips.control: Tap sample, keyboard activate or Squeeze button; then profile-specific recovery.

clips.response: Exponential slow rise, no spring overshoot.
Bounded damped oscillation; negative depth is capped at -0.18.

registration: Largest foreground component bounds registered per frame; all images retained unchanged; common support pivot and common apparent rest width. Frame7 returns to frame0 for rest.
quiet: Display still samples; explicit auto trial completes logically without requiring motion. Help remains non-mutating.
interruption: New input supersedes the single owned cycle; pause, blur, resize and scene exit abandon an unfinished cycle; pointercancel releases visually without qualifying a trial.
